author: haiku
label: climb-05-01
changes: Added a plain summary paragraph at the top that says what the pipeline does, how the live path and replay flow, and why it is shaped that way.

Added a terms section defining each term the steps use (event, batch, collector, envelope, partition, log, offset, raw archive, dedup store, first copy, micro-batch, enrichment version, staging and quarantine tables, watermark, closed day).
Rewrote each live and replay step so it states what starts it, what it does, what keeps its data and what happens when it goes wrong, in short sentences.
Replaced the 'Step 6.2' and similar cross-references with plain descriptions, and removed the R-style and step-number lookups where a reader would need to jump back.
Moved the failure handling into one table covering each failure, what happens, and what keeps the data.
Separated the build and rollout content (assumptions to confirm and checks during rollout) from how the system runs.
Merged the risk section with the assumptions and checks, and folded the winner-ordering note into the replay section where it explains the difference between live and replay.
Cut the requirements cross-check table. It only pointed to step numbers and does not help a newcomer follow the main flow.
Kept the bot-traffic decision open in the plan, at the same point (between enrichment and the load), and kept all three open decisions under Open questions.

Did not change any behavior from the original plan. The timings, retention, TTLs, admission limits, the D+80 margin and the 02:00 close are unchanged. Stated the 8-day dedup key's dependence on the 7-day buffer more directly in the rollout checks.
